title: PHP 7.4.3 released
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.4.3. This is a security release which also contains several bug fixes.

All PHP 7.4 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 7.4.3 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
